messages.message: ### Step 2: Morphosyntactic Requirement Definition Goal: For Esperanto, specify per-token morphosyntax needed to realize the Step 1 Interpretation Lock. Output: ONE Markdown table only (no prose). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Requirement] In [Target Requirement]: make comparative ordering+degree explicit and add a 1-line literal back-translation check.

| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Requirement (Esperanto) | |-------------|----------------------|---------------------------------| | **Tant'** | Intensifier of “bitter”. | **tiom** [adv] – “so”; literal back‑translation: *so* | | **è** (1st) | Copular link (subject = implicit “it”). | **estas** [verb, 3sg pres.] – “is”; back‑translation: *is* | | **amara** | Predicate adjective “bitter”. | **amara** [adj] – “bitter”; back‑translation: *bitter* | | **che** (comparative) | Introduces comparative clause. | **ol** [conj] – “than/that”; back‑translation: *that* | | **poco** | Degree adverb “little, slightly”. | **iom** [adv] – “a little”; back‑translation: *little* | | **è** (2nd) | Copular verb in comparative clause. | **estas** [verb, 3sg pres.] – “is”; back‑translation: *is* | | **più** | Comparative adverb “more”. | **pli** [adv, comp.] – “more”; back‑translation: *more* | | **morte** | Noun “death”, the term that exceeds “bitter”. | **mort** [noun] + **o** (mort**o**) – “death”; back‑translation: *death* | | **ma** | Coordinating conjunction “but”. | **sed** [conj] – “but”; back‑translation: *but* | | **per** | Preposition marking purpose. | **por** [prep] – “in order to”; back‑translation: *for* | | **trattar** | Infinitive “to treat / discuss”. | **trakti** [verb, inf.] – “to treat”; back‑translation: *to treat* | | **del** | Prepositional phrase “of the”. | **de la** [prep + def.art] – “of the”; back‑translation: *of the* | | **ben** | Noun “good”. | **bono** [noun] – “good”; back‑translation: *good* | | **ch'** (relative) | Relative pronoun “that”. | **kiu** [rel.pron] – “that”; back‑translation: *that* | | **i'** | First‑person pronoun “I”. | **mi** [pron] – “I”; back‑translation: *I* | | **vi** | Locative adverb “there”. | **tie** [adv] – “there”; back‑translation: *there* | | **trovai** | Past tense “found”. | **trovis** [verb, past] – “found”; back‑translation: *found* | | **dirò** | Future tense “I will tell”. | **diros** [verb, 1sg fut.] – “I will tell”; back‑translation: *I will tell* | | **de** | Preposition “of”. | **pri** [prep] – “about/of”; back‑translation: *about* | | **l'altre** | Determiner + adjective “the other”. | **la aliaj** [def.art + adj] – “the other”; back‑translation: *the other* | | **cose** | Noun “things”. | **aĵoj** [noun pl.] – “things”; back‑translation: *things* | | **ch'** (second relative) | Relative pronoun “that”. | **kiuj** [rel.pron, pl.] – “that (plural)”; back‑translation: *that* | | **i'** (second) | First‑person pronoun “I”. | **mi** [pron] – “I”; back‑translation: *I* | | **v'** | Locative adverb “there”. | **tie** [adv] – “there”; back‑translation: *there* | | **ho** | Auxiliary “have”. | **havas** [verb, pres.] – “have”; back‑translation: *have* | | **scorte** | Past participle “seen”. | **vidintaj** [participle, pl.] – “seen”; back‑translation: *seen* |
**Notes on comparative ordering & degree** - The sequence **“mort**o** estas iom pli granda ol amara”** (death is a little more great than bitter) makes the ordering explicit (death > bitter) and encodes the slight degree with **iom** (little) + **pli** (more). - The literal back‑translation check in each row confirms that the Esperanto token preserves the intended English meaning.

### Step 3: Pre-assembled Lexical Inventory Output: bullet list only; one line per source line. Format: - Line <ID>: <Phrase 1> / <Phrase 2> / <Phrase 3> Rules: each phrase is directly placeable (no glue-only fragments) and covers the line’s main predicate + required linkage. Hook: satisfy Step 2 requirements for that line (incl. back-translation checks). Comparatives: preserve ordering (A>B ⇔ B<A is OK) and degree; at least one phrase must make both recoverable. No punctuation inside phrases; keep phrases short; no newlines.

- Line 7: mort estas iom pli granda ol amara / mort estas iom pli ol amara / mort estas iom pli granda ol amara - Line 8: por trakti bonon kiun mi trovis tie / por diskuti bonon kiun mi trovis tie / por paroli pri bono kiun mi trovis tie - Line 9: mi diros pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie / mi rakontos pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie / mi diros pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie

### Step 4: Slot-Based Syntactic Assembly Task: Assemble Step3 phrases into Esperanto lines; keep the same number of lines. Use Step3 phrases as contiguous substrings; reorder within line as needed. Allowed edits: insert only function-words/morphology for grammatical joining; no new content words. Avoid flat modifier stacking: make intended attachment/roles explicit using available function-words/morphology. Punctuation: copy only end punctuation to line end; add no internal punctuation. Comparatives: preserve ordering+degree; make compared entities explicit if otherwise ambiguous. Output per source line (labels verbatim): Source Line: <copy exact source line> Line Inventory: - <copy the phrases you chose from Step 3 for this line> Assembly Notes: - If you inserted any function-words/morphology for joining, list them briefly. Target Text: <assembled target line> If you forgot a necessary Step3 phrase: re-insert it (no new content words).

**Source Line:** 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;
**Line Inventory:** - mort estas iom pli ol amara
**Assembly Notes:** - No additional function‑words needed; the phrase already contains the copula *estas* and the comparative markers *iom* + *pli* + *ol* to make the ordering and degree explicit.
**Target Text:** mort estas iom pli ol amara;
**Source Line:** 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,
**Line Inventory:** - por trakti bonon kiun mi trovis tie
**Assembly Notes:** - Inserted coordinating conjunction **sed** to render the contrastive “ma”. - The phrase supplies the purpose preposition **por**, infinitive **trakti**, direct object **bonon**, relative clause **kiun mi trovis tie**.
**Target Text:** sed por trakti bonon kiun mi trovis tie,
**Source Line:** 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.
**Line Inventory:** - mi diros pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie
**Assembly Notes:** - No extra words needed; the future verb **diros**, preposition **pri**, noun phrase **la aliaj aĵoj**, and relative clause **kiujn mi vidis tie** fulfill the required morphosyntax.
**Target Text:** mi diros pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie.

### Step 5: Self-Correction via Back-Translation & Grammatical Check For each line: verify Step4 Target Text vs Reference Translation + Step1 Locked Meaning; correct within-line only. Allowed: reorder within line; add only function-words/morphology; never add new content words; never move across lines. Punctuation: keep only end punctuation from source; no internal punctuation. Output per line bullets with EXACT fields (no extras): Line #, Target Text, Back-Translation, Reference Translation, Checks, Corrected Target Text (if any). Checks: End Punct <OK|FAIL>, Coverage <OK|FAIL>, Meaning Drift <OK|FAIL>, Comparative Orientation <OK|FAIL|N/A>, Hallucination <OK|FAIL> If any FAIL: Corrected Target Text MUST make all checks OK if possible. Comparative Orientation: preserve ordering+degree; treat (A>B) ≡ (B<A) and (A<B) ≡ (B>A); FAIL only if ordering reversed or degree lost. After all lines: if any line still FAILs, output UNVERIFIED with failing Line #s; otherwise do not output UNVERIFIED. Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 7 Target Text: mort estas iom pli ol amara; Back-Translation: “death is a little more than bitter;” Reference Translation: So bitter is it that death is little more. Checks: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation OK, Hallucination OK Corrected Target Text:
- Line 8 Target Text: sed por trakti bonon kiun mi trovis tie, Back-Translation: “but in order to treat the good that I found there,” Reference Translation: But in order to treat of the good that there I found, Checks: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK Corrected Target Text:
- Line 9 Target Text: mi diros pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie. Back-Translation: “I will tell about the other things that I saw there.” Reference Translation: I will tell of the other things that I have seen there. Checks: End Punct OK, Coverage OK, Meaning Drift OK, Comparative Orientation N/A, Hallucination OK Corrected Target Text:
``` mort estas iom pli ol amara; sed por trakti bonon kiun mi trovis tie, mi diros pri la aliaj aĵoj kiujn mi vidis tie. ```
